verdict: The render reproduces the trapezoid ABCD faithfully: four segments, correct vertex positions, parallel AB and CD, and all four labels bound to the correct vertices. The only difference is label placement, which is low severity.

figure_type.original: Quadrilateral ABCD drawn as a trapezoid with horizontal parallel sides AB (longer, bottom) and CD (shorter, top), with no interior construction lines.
figure_type.render: Quadrilateral ABCD drawn as a trapezoid with horizontal parallel sides AB (bottom) and CD (top), with no interior construction lines.

issues.description: Vertex labels are placed differently from the original. In the original, A and B sit beside their vertices at roughly the vertex's height (A to the left, B to the right), and D and C sit beside their vertices (D to the left, C to the right). In the render, all four labels are pushed diagonally outward and further from the vertices, with A and B below and D and C above. The association with each vertex stays clear.
